import torch
from anatobind.aur.model import AnatoBindBrain
torch.set_num_threads(2)
cfg = dict(embed=32, depths=(1,1,1,1), heads=(1,2,4,8), d_model=32, n_events=2, mask_dim=8, pixel_dim=16, dec_layers=1, dec_heads=1, rel_layers=1, rel_heads=1, use_checkpoint=False)
model = AnatoBindBrain(**cfg).eval()
for depth in (1,2):
    image = torch.zeros(1,1,depth,32,32)
    valid = torch.ones(1,depth,32,32)
    coords = torch.stack(torch.meshgrid(torch.arange(depth), torch.arange(32), torch.arange(32), indexing="ij")).float()[None]
    local = torch.zeros_like(coords)
    try:
        with torch.inference_mode():
            out = model(image, valid, coords, local)
            a = model.entity_masks(out)
            u = model.event_masks(out)
            r = model.bind(out, 0, torch.tensor([0]))
            print({"patch_depth":2,"input_depth":depth,"A_shape":tuple(a.shape),"U_shape":tuple(u.shape),"R_shape":tuple(r.shape)})
    except ValueError as exc:
        print({"patch_depth":2,"input_depth":depth,"error":str(exc)})
model1 = AnatoBindBrain(**cfg, patch=(1,4,4)).eval()
with torch.inference_mode():
    image = torch.zeros(1,1,1,32,32)
    valid = torch.ones(1,1,32,32)
    coords = torch.stack(torch.meshgrid(torch.arange(1), torch.arange(32), torch.arange(32), indexing="ij")).float()[None]
    out = model1(image,valid,coords,torch.zeros_like(coords))
    print({"patch_depth":1,"input_depth":1,"A_shape":tuple(model1.entity_masks(out).shape),"U_shape":tuple(model1.event_masks(out).shape),"R_shape":tuple(model1.bind(out,0,torch.tensor([0])).shape)})
print({"shape_changes":{k:(tuple(v.shape),tuple(model1.state_dict()[k].shape)) for k,v in model.state_dict().items() if v.shape != model1.state_dict()[k].shape}})
